Gold.note: Central bank buying and rate cut expectations offset strong year-to-date gains.

Silver.note: Industrial solar demand and precious metal momentum support further upside.

Copper.note: Tight smelter treatment charges and green energy transition offset weak China property.

Uranium.note: Structural primary supply deficit and global nuclear renaissance drive long-term contracting.

Lithium.note: Persistent oversupply from new projects and slowing EV battery demand growth.

Nickel.note: Indonesian supply surge and battery chemistry shifts weigh on prices despite low costs.

Zinc.note: Concentrate supply tightness from mine closures supports smelter margins and prices.

Iron Ore.note: Chinese property sector weakness offsets marginal infrastructure stimulus.

Coal.note: Thermal coal demand peaks amid energy transition, though met coal remains resilient.

Rare Earths.note: Strategic stockpiling and EV motor demand offset by steady Chinese supply.

Manganese.note: Steady steel production demand balanced by ample South African and Gabonese supply.

PGM.note: Declining internal combustion engine sales offset by platinum substitution and hydrogen potential.

Potash.note: Global agricultural demand remains stable as supply chains normalize post-geopolitical shocks.

Aluminum.note: Capacity curtailments in China and green energy demand tighten the market balance.

Diversified.note: Balanced exposure to copper and iron ore provides resilience amid mixed macro signals.
